# lantronix-slcxx-o2_port_access (Resource)

Network access services of one SLC Device Port (Telnet In / SSH In / raw TCP In). Destroying this resource disables all three services.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Device Port number these access settings belong to.

### Optional

- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle disconnect in seconds (1-9999); 0 means disabled.
- `ssh_auth` (Boolean) Require SLC login over SSH (device default: enabled).
- `ssh_enabled` (Boolean) SSH In service on this port.
- `ssh_port` (Number) Listener override.
- `tcp_auth` (Boolean) Require SLC login for raw TCP (device default: disabled).
- `tcp_enabled` (Boolean) Raw TCP In service on this port.
- `tcp_port` (Number) Listener override.
- `telnet_auth` (Boolean) Require SLC login before bridging (device default: enabled).
- `telnet_enabled` (Boolean) Telnet In service on this port.
- `telnet_port` (Number) Listener override; default is the derived global base + port - 1.
